item.title: TiagoLr just released Sirial, a FREE rhythmic serial delay plugin
item.description: Sirial is a rhythmic serial delay inspired by “tap mode” by the SoundToys EchoBoy. The plugin works on macOS, Windows, and Linux. The developer has already brought us several amazing freeware plugins inspired by paid software, such as FILT-R, which somewhat recreates the Cableguys FilterShaper plugin. item.title: Give your single channel MIDI keyboard polyphonic expression for FREE with MPE Emulator
item.description: MPE Emulator by Attila Magyar is a plugin that provides your ordinary MIDI controllers with new polyphonic expression capabilities and a lot of room for customization! item.title: The Triad multi-algorithm distortion plugin by Carbon Fiber is FREE for a limited time
item.description: The Triad is a three-way distortion plugin from developer Carbon Fiber, billed as “the triangle of destruction” due to its triangular X/Y pad at its core. item.title: Vocal Hut is giving away 3 FREE royalty-free EDM vocal stems exclusively for BPB readers
item.description: Robbie Hutton from Vocal Hut has put together a free vocal pack exclusively for BPB readers. The pack includes three full-length, royalty-free EDM vocals with dry and wet stems, MIDI files, and lyrics folders. Everything is in WAV format and ready to drop into your projects.
